title: Not Great on Carpet; Lightweight
text:
Not Great on Carpet; Lightweight. I selected this vacuum cleaner with the hopes that it would be a suitable replacement for a very cheap and inexpensive upright vacuum cleaner. I’ve had good experiences with Black+Decker tools as well as kitchen appliances, so part of my reason for selecting it was based on brand recognition. It has been a big let-down and I can’t recommend this vacuum cleaner without reservation except in specific cases and for specific uses.

Almost everything about this vacuum feels like it was made with lower-quality materials, the exception being the metal extending tube which is actually solid and well-made. The plastic tubing to which it attaches is cheap and is held to the metal tube only by friction, not unlike pipe fitting without adhesives. The attachments also feel substandard, and the housing feels lightweight.

The main attachment which is used for carpet and hardwood is probably the biggest issue with this whole system. It does not work smoothly on carpet and it takes real effort to get it to roll. I thought perhaps I had the lever on it set wrong (the lever moves the leading brush which is useful for pet hair), and that wasn’t it – moving the lever so it protruded the brush made it appreciably worse. I did figure out that on carpet, turning down the power does make it roll better, but then the suction is reduced and it doesn’t pick up as well anyway. Slightly larger wheels would solve this issue, I think.

When using with the edge attachment or small brush, this vacuum becomes a serious contender. This has a lot of power and it can definitely suck up dirt and debris from small spaces. I did not understand the reasoning behind the variable speeds – at first. Once I realized that full power is not always ideal, I got better results and found the unit easier to maneuver. The power level also affects loudness too so it can be operated at slower speeds when quieter operation is desired.

When the metal extension is removed from the mix, this vacuum works quite well as a car vacuum. It is powerful enough to get most things out of the flooring and from between the seat and base. The brush works well for dusting the dash as well. It’s also excellent on hardwood floors and linoleum where there is no carpet with which to contend.

The unit is lightweight and relatively easy to carry. It is not as easy to carry as a cordless upright, but it is not a tank either.

I have mixed feelings about this vacuum cleaner. On one hand, it does a sub-optimal job on carpet due to the design of the floor attachment and the overall unit feels of substandard quality. On the other hand, it is good on non-carpet floors and it has plenty of power. Your mileage may vary. For me, this isn’t my first choice when I need to vacuum my living room but is my go to when I want to clean my car.
